content:
Alex: Quick sync — propose we trial a 10-min 'rapid triage pulse' at every shift overlap (UTC 08:00 & 20:00) for the next 2 weeks. Focus: handoff highlights, open incidents requiring attention, and any rollout blockers. Thoughts?

Priya: +1. I like 10m, keeps it tight. Can we rotate the facilitator between oncall and SRE every day? :thumbsup:

Jordan: Works for me. Can we set agenda template? E.g.: 1) open incidents (priority+owner) 2) rollouts 3) blocked pages 4) quick action items. Also want a 1-liner per incident.

Sam: Agree on template. Suggest adding "expected followup" field. Also, can the oncall-bot post a summary automatically 5 min before?

oncall-bot: Scheduled backup: posting 10-minute pre-sync summary in #eng-oncall at 1709456340. Summary includes active incidents and recent sev changes. (automated)

Nina: I'll own facilitator for tomorrow's 08:00 UTC slot. Can someone add me to the calendar invite?

Alex: @Nina added — calendar invite created: https://calendar.redwood.ai/event/rapid-pulse (placeholder). I added agenda in the description.

Priya: For open incidents, here's current list: INC-402 (ingest queue lag) — owner Jordan, priority P1, ETA fix 1h; INC-410 (model memory leak) — owner Sam, P2, investigating. Please add 1-line statuses in the meeting.

Jordan: update on INC-402: restarted worker pool, lag down 60%, tail latency improving. Plan: follow up with config tweak, ETA 45m.

Sam: INC-410: reproducible on staging, root cause seems GPU mem leak in a specific model variant. Mitigation: pinned to v1.4 on prod. Will roll a canary to one node at noon.

Alex: Good. For escalation attendance: need someone with DB creds on-call for P0s — @OpsLead can you confirm coverage? If not, we need a designated backup.

OpsLead: I can be on rotation for core DB escalations but only during 08:00-18:00 UTC. After that we need another backup. @Priya maybe?

Priya: I can cover weekends nights occasionally. Let's put a rota: OpsLead (08-18 UTC), Priya (18-02 UTC), Jordan (02-08 UTC). Volunteers?

Jordan: I'm ok for nights this week. Can we list this in the runbook?

Sam: I'll update runbook snippet: 
```
Escalation rota:
- 08-18 UTC: OpsLead
- 18-02 UTC: Priya
- 02-08 UTC: Jordan
```

Alex: Nice. Also quick request: when posting incident updates in the pulse, please include "what changed" + "next expected step" — keeps it actionable.

Nina: For the 10-min format, we need to enforce timeboxing. Proposed facilitator script: 2min quick headlines, 4min open incidents, 2min rollouts/blockers, 2min assign follow-ups.

Priya: Love the script. Can we trial for 2 weeks and then review in #eng-sre retro?

Alex: Agreed. I'll set a short survey after 2 weeks.

Jordan: One more ask: code review pings — if incident requires a hotfix PR review, mark message with :review: so reviewers can triage.

Sam: We'll use label [hotfix-review] in PR title. Also add link to PR in the pulse.

oncall-bot: New incident alarm: INC-415 detected at 1709458800 — severity P1, source: streaming-proxy. Link: https://incidents.redwood.ai/INC-415

Alex: Noted. We'll call it out in the pulse at 20:00 UTC. @Jordan can you take initial triage?

Jordan: On it, joining now.

Nina: I'll run the 20:00 pulse and start with a 30s summary of INC-415. Who will produce the 1-line update? Jordan, Sam?

Jordan: I'll post triage summary in-thread and add next steps.

Sam: If PR needed, I'll be reviewer for model runtime changes.

Alex: Great. Also add a tiny checklist in calendar invite: "Pre-sync: oncall-bot summary posted, facilitator assigned, runbook link open". Put runbook link: https://docs.redwood.ai/runbooks/oncall-handoff

Priya: Ack. Will add "minute-taker" rotation as well.

OpsLead: Confirmed DB backup coverage this week per rota.

Nina: Last: can we try this cadence only for peak weeks (release windows) first? Might be heavy to do daily always.

Alex: Start for next 2 weeks (covers release), then revisit. If it feels heavy we can drop to weekdays.

Jordan: Sounds good.

oncall-bot: Closing note: pulse trial scheduled for 1709457600, recurring daily at 08:00 & 20:00 UTC for 2 weeks. Reminder 10m before. (automated)

Alex: thanks everyone — see you at 08:00 UTC. :rocket:
